resources.string: The server requires a device ID (HWID) but did not accept it. Check the subscription settings in your panel.
The subscription device limit has been reached. Remove an unused device or increase the limit in your panel, then retry.
The server denied access to this subscription. Check that the client is enabled and access has not expired.
The server could not find the subscription or rejected this device. Copy the current URL from your panel and check client access.
Too many subscription requests. Wait a moment and retry.
The subscription server is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
The server rejected this subscription request. Check client access and subscription settings in your panel.
Could not connect to the subscription server. Check your internet connection and whether the address is reachable.
The server returned an empty subscription. Check that connections are assigned to this client.
The server response has no supported profiles. Use a subscription containing VLESS links, rather than a panel web page.
